records.context: Distance-one controls have exactly one nearest guide and use a different substituted position for each accepted control of that guide. Distance-two controls have no guide at distance zero or one. Every control lies at least two substitutions from previously accepted and excluded controls. Sorted unique guides are visited in order, accepting up to k controls before moving to the next guide. One seeded generator makes up to 200 total attempts per guide, matching the reference order. The same builder serves full-barcode and sequenced-prefix calibration.

records.translation: 距离为一的对照恰有一条最近引导 RNA，该引导 RNA每个获接纳的对照使用不同的替换位置。距离为二的对照在距离零或一处均没有引导 RNA。每个对照与先前接纳及排除的对照之间至少相差两次替换。依次遍历排序后的唯一引导 RNA，在转到下一条引导 RNA 前接纳最多 k 个对照。使用一个带种子的生成器，每条引导 RNA 总计最多尝试 200 次，与参考顺序一致。同一构建器用于完整条形码和已测序前缀的校准。
